description: Target launch overhead on n=32/176/352 with a Triton small-matrix QR path: one program handles one or several matrices, keeps full or partial columns in SRAM/registers, and emits torch.geqrf-compatible compact Householder output.

Target compute and memory throughput on large-batch n=512 cases with a Triton blocked panel QR: many matrices per launch, vectorized dot/norm reductions, stable rank-def handling, and compact geqrf-compatible writes.

Target n=1024/2048/4096 redundant work and launch overhead with a Triton blocked QR using panel factorization plus trailing-update kernels, using any PyTorch fallback only as a temporary correctness escape hatch rather than the final path.

Extend the validated n=32 Triton QR win to medium matrices with a staged panel Householder QR using compact WY/block updates for n in {64,96,128,176}; use multiple compact Triton kernels over panels, avoid monolithic n=512-style kernels and content dispatch, preserve the n=32 path, and fall back only for unsupported sizes or numerical failures.

Combine global-best exact n=32/n=176 Triton Householder QR with the large rankdef/nearrank truncated leading-3/4-panel path. Preserve dispatch priority: exact small sizes use Triton kernels first; only safely classified large rankdef/nearrank cases take the truncated-panel shortcut; dense, mixed, or uncertain large inputs fall back to torch.geqrf with unchanged correctness.

Profile the current best on n=352, then build a shape-specific Triton custom-kernel path that attacks launch/copy overhead from the failed n=352 attempt: fuse or remove redundant H-panel movement/update work, gate strictly to n=352, and preserve existing n=32/n=176/large-rankdef paths unless n=352 and geomean improve.

Profile n=512 dense/mixed large-batch bottlenecks, then build a true split Triton blocked panel/update QR path borrowing the successful n=352 reflector/update-kernel structure. Do not add content-dispatch or new rankdef shortcuts; preserve existing small and rankdef/nearrank paths, and fall back automatically if the n=512 path regresses.

Target untouched large n=1024 dense/mixed/upper QR cases by adding a shape-gated Triton split panel/update or preprocessing path that reduces torch.geqrf overhead while preserving existing n=32/176/352 dispatch and rankdef/nearrank shortcuts; generalize to n=2048/4096 only if the n=1024 structure scales cleanly, with no content-specific hacks.

Combine the global-best n=512 split-QR tile32 path with the n=352 tile64 update improvement, resolving dispatch conflicts while keeping the existing small-size and rankdef/nearrank shortcut paths intact so both improvements can stack.

Add a shape-gated large-n split Triton QR path for untouched n=2048 dense/upper cases, borrowing the n=512 panel/update split but retuning tiles for large matrices. Preserve n=32/176/352/512 behavior and rankdef/nearrank shortcuts; avoid n=1024 overlap. Generalize to n=4096 only after n=2048 validates and scales.

Combine the global-best n=512 tile64 split-QR update path with the n=352 tile64 update improvement, preserving existing n=32/n=176 and rankdef/nearrank shortcuts while resolving dispatch conflicts and testing whether the n=352 specialization stacks cleanly.

Combine the global-best n=512 tile64 split QR with the n=1024 tile32 split QR path: base on the global best, import only the shape-gated n=1024 specialization, preserve n=32/176/352 plus rankdef/nearrank shortcuts, and resolve dispatch ordering so n=512 remains unchanged while n=1024 stacks cleanly.

For n=512, replace the split-QR per-column reflector update with a blocked panel/multi-reflector update such as compact WY or block Householder to reduce Triton launch count. Preserve current dispatch behavior, n=32/176/352/1024 paths, and rankdef/nearrank shortcuts; fall back to the existing n=512 tile64 split QR if validation fails or benchmarks regress.

Combine dispatch-specialized QR fast paths by stacking the current n=352 tile64 plus n=512 tile64 global-best with the validated n=1024 tile32 split path, fixing dispatch interference so n=352/n=512/n=1024 all route correctly while preserving n=32/n=176 and rankdef/nearrank shortcuts.

Combine the n=352/n=512 tile64 stack with the large upper-triangular identity-copy QR fast path to remove redundant QR work on already-upper inputs: preserve n=32/n=176 and rankdef/nearrank shortcuts, add the n=2048 identity-copy path behind safe triangular dispatch, and avoid n=1024 overlap with worker0.

Combine the n=512 fused two-reflector global-best path with the n=352 tile64 and n=1024 tile32 dispatch stack, resolving QR dispatch conflicts so n=512 keeps the fused path while n=352/n1024 and existing n=32/176/rankdef/nearrank shortcuts still route correctly.

Combine the global-best n=512 quad-reflector fused QR path with the n=352 tile64 and n=1024 tile32 size-dispatch stack, preserving existing n=32/n=176 and rankdef/nearrank shortcuts while making dispatch precedence route n=512 to quad, n=352 to tile64, and n=1024 to tile32.

Target n=32 launch overhead by replacing the current one-program-per-matrix Triton Householder QR path with a custom grouped/batched Triton kernel that processes multiple 32x32 matrices per program or launch, preserves compact geqrf output and dispatch semantics, and profiles whether reduced launch/program overhead beats the existing small-n path.

Extend the n=512 four-reflector blocked QR path to eight reflectors per panel, targeting launch overhead and redundant update work via compact WY/register-staged state or two staged quad subpanels while preserving the existing dispatch split and quad path fallback.

Profile the n=1024 path, then reduce launch count with a custom Triton fused two-reflector update kernel, expanding toward quad-fused only if register pressure and occupancy stay healthy. Route only n=1024 through this path while preserving existing n=32/n=512 behavior and the current dispatch split.

Extend the n=512 blocked QR best path by accumulating two 8-reflector oct subpanels before the trailing update, then apply one fused 16-reflector/128-column update to reduce launch count and redundant memory traffic while preserving the current dispatch rules and oct fallback.

Integrate the n=512 oct-reflector panel/update path with the n=1024 pair-fused Triton update, refactoring size dispatch so n=512 selects oct, n=1024 selects pair-fused, and existing n=32/rankdef/nearrank shortcuts remain intact.
Integrate the n=32 GROUP=2 grouped Triton QR path into the global-best dispatch, preserving rankdef/nearrank handling and existing size routes while keeping the n=512 oct path unchanged.

Combine global-best n=512 16-reflector trailing update with the validated n=1024 pair-fused update path; resolve dispatch so n=512 selects the 16-reflector kernel and n=1024 selects pair-fused, while preserving existing n=32 and rankdef/nearrank fast paths without broad retuning.

Target n=2048/4096 dense and upper cases with a custom Triton blocked-WY/panel QR update: group reflectors into panels, form and apply compact V/T-style updates with GEMM-like tiled kernels, avoiding the previous per-column large-n path that timed out.

Integrate 487a328's n=32 GROUP=2 two-warp grouped Triton QR dispatch into f3d00b9 as the base, preserving rankdef/nearrank handling and all existing size routes; keep n=512 16-reflector fused trailing update unchanged, and make no n=1024/n=2048/n=4096 changes.

Redesign the dense n=512 Triton QR path to cut launch count and redundant global-memory traffic by fusing panel/reflector generation with the 16-reflector trailing update or using a persistent tiled kernel that keeps panel data resident across multiple column tiles; preserve n=1024 pair-fused update plus n=32/rankdef/nearrank shortcuts.

Combine fd60be99 with the validated 9bd7ec8 n=32 GROUP=2 two-warp Triton QR path, preserving n=512 16-reflector, n=1024 pair-fused, rankdef/nearrank, and large-size routes; resolve conflicts conservatively around dispatch and complete benchmark/profile for a real metric.
